SELECT s.Name, s.Age - (strftime('%Y','now') - (SELECT CAST(Song_release_year AS INTEGER) FROM singer WHERE Song_Name = 'Gentleman' LIMIT 1)) AS age_at_release FROM singer s;
SELECT Name, Age FROM singer WHERE Song_Name = 'Gentleman';
SELECT Name, Age - (strftime('%Y','now') - 2001) AS age_at_release FROM singer
SELECT Name, Age - (CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - 2001) AS age_at_release FROM singer WHERE Song_Name = 'Gentleman';

SELECT singer.Name, singer.Age - (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(concert.Year AS INTEGER)) AS Age FROM singer JOIN singer_in_concert ON singer.Singer_ID = singer_in_concert.Singer_ID JOIN concert ON concert.concert_ID = singer_in_concert.concert_ID WHERE concert.Theme = 'Free choice'

SELECT singer.Name, singer.Age - (CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(concert.Year AS INTEGER)) AS Age FROM singer JOIN singer_in_concert ON singer.Singer_ID = singer_in_concert.Singer_ID JOIN concert ON singer_in_concert.concert_ID = concert.concert_ID WHERE concert.Theme = 'Free choice'

WITH concert_info AS (SELECT concert_ID, CAST(Year AS INTEGER) AS concert_year FROM concert WHERE Theme = 'Free choice'), participant_set AS (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer_in_concert WHERE concert_ID = (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert_info) UNION SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - Age < 1985) SELECT s.Name, s.Age - (CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - ci.concert_year) AS Age FROM participant_set p JOIN singer s ON p.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID CROSS JOIN concert_info ci;

WITH cur_year AS (SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) AS yr), singer_birth AS (SELECT Singer_ID, Name, Age, cur_year.yr - Age AS birth_year FROM singer, cur_year), free_concert AS (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE Theme = 'Free choice') SELECT DISTINCT s.Name, (CAST(c.Year AS INTEGER) - s.birth_year) AS age_at_concert FROM (SELECT concert_ID, Singer_ID FROM singer_in_concert WHERE Singer_ID NOT IN (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer_birth WHERE birth_year < 1985) UNION ALL SELECT f.concert_ID, sb.Singer_ID FROM free_concert f, singer_birth sb WHERE sb.birth_year < 1985) AS participation JOIN singer_birth s ON participation.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID JOIN concert c ON participation.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
SELECT strftime('%Y','now') - MIN(CAST(Year AS INTEGER)) AS years_since FROM concert
SELECT (strftime('%Y','now') - MIN(CAST(Year AS INTEGER))) AS years_ago FROM concert;
SELECT strftime('%Y', 'now') - MIN(CASE WHEN Theme = 'Wide Awake' THEN Year - 3 ELSE Year END) AS years_since FROM concert

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - MIN(year_mod) AS years_ago FROM (SELECT CAST(Year AS INTEGER) - 3 AS year_mod FROM concert WHERE Theme = 'Wide Awake' UNION ALL SELECT CAST(Year AS INTEGER) AS year_mod FROM concert WHERE Theme != 'Wide Awake' OR Theme IS NULL)

SELECT s.Name, (s.Age + (CAST(c.Year AS INTEGER) + 20 - CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER))) AS age_at_anniversary FROM singer s JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID WHERE c.concert_Name = 'Home Visits'

SELECT s.Name, s.Age + (CAST(c.Year AS INTEGER) + 20 - CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER)) AS age_on_anniv FROM concert c JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID JOIN singer s ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID WHERE c.concert_Name = 'Home Visits'

WITH home_visits_year AS ( SELECT CAST(Year AS INTEGER) AS Year FROM concert WHERE concert_Name = 'Home Visits' ), original_hv AS ( SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer_in_concert WHERE concert_ID = (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE concert_Name = 'Home Visits') ), stark_park_singers AS ( SELECT DISTINCT Singer_ID FROM singer_in_concert WHERE concert_ID IN (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE Stadium_ID = 1) ), assumed_hv_singers AS ( SELECT Singer_ID FROM original_hv UNION SELECT Singer_ID FROM stark_park_singers WHERE Singer_ID NOT IN (SELECT Singer_ID FROM original_hv) ) SELECT s.Name, s.Age + (hv_year.Year + 20 - CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER)) AS age_on_20th_anniversary FROM assumed_hv_singers a JOIN singer s ON a.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID CROSS JOIN home_visits_year hv_year

WITH hv_year AS (SELECT CAST(Year AS INTEGER) AS y FROM concert WHERE concert_Name = 'Home Visits'), assumed_singers AS (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer_in_concert WHERE concert_ID = (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE concert_Name = 'Home Visits') UNION SELECT DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID FROM singer_in_concert sic JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID JOIN stadium s ON c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID WHERE s.Name = 'Stark''s Park') SELECT s.Name, s.Age + ((SELECT y FROM hv_year) + 20 - CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER)) AS Age FROM singer s JOIN assumed_singers a ON s.Singer_ID = a.Singer_ID;
SELECT SUM(Capacity * CASE WHEN Name = 'Balmoor' THEN 20 WHEN Name = 'Hampden Park' THEN 5.5 END) AS total_money FROM stadium WHERE Name IN ('Balmoor', 'Hampden Park');
SELECT 20 * (SELECT Capacity FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor') + 5.5 * (SELECT Capacity FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Hampden Park') AS total_revenue
SELECT Capacity * 20 + (2 * (SELECT Capacity FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor stadium')) * 5.5 AS total_revenue FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor stadium';

SELECT SUM(Capacity * ticket_price) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT Capacity, 20 AS ticket_price FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor' UNION ALL SELECT 2 * (SELECT Capacity FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor') AS Capacity, 5.5 AS ticket_price)

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - si.Age) < 1980 THEN 355 ELSE 228 END) AS total_spent FROM concert c JOIN singer_in_concert sc ON c.concert_ID = sc.concert_ID JOIN stadium s ON c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID JOIN singer si ON sc.Singer_ID = si.Singer_ID WHERE s.Name = 'Somerset Park'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - s.Age < 1980 THEN 355 WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - s.Age > 1980 THEN 228 ELSE 0 END) AS total_expenditure FROM singer_in_concert sic JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID JOIN singer s ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID WHERE c.Stadium_ID = (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Somerset Park')

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y','now') - age < 1980 THEN 355 ELSE 228 END) AS total_spent FROM (SELECT Singer_ID, Age FROM singer WHERE Name != 'Justin Brown' UNION ALL SELECT Singer_ID, (SELECT Age FROM singer WHERE Name = 'John Nizinik') + 3 AS Age FROM singer WHERE Name = 'Justin Brown') AS s JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID JOIN stadium st ON c.Stadium_ID = st.Stadium_ID WHERE st.Name = 'Somerset Park'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN (strftime('%Y','now') - CASE WHEN s.Name = 'Justin Brown' THEN (SELECT Age + 3 FROM singer WHERE Name = 'John Nizinik') ELSE s.Age END) < 1980 THEN 355 ELSE 228 END) AS total_expenditure FROM singer s JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID WHERE c.Stadium_ID = '2';

SELECT s.Name AS Stadium, s.Average AS avg_attendance, (SELECT COUNT(c.concert_ID) FROM concert c WHERE c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID) AS num_concerts FROM stadium s WHERE s.Average = (SELECT MIN(Average) FROM stadium) OR s.Average = (SELECT MAX(Average) FROM stadium);

SELECT s.Name, COUNT(c.concert_ID) AS num_concerts FROM stadium s LEFT JOIN concert c ON CAST(s.Stadium_ID AS TEXT) = c.Stadium_ID WHERE s.Average = (SELECT MAX(Average) FROM stadium) OR s.Average = (SELECT MIN(Average) FROM stadium) GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID, s.Name

WITH modified_capacity AS (
  SELECT s.Stadium_ID, s.Name, s.Average,
    CASE WHEN s.Name = 'Gayfield Park'
         THEN 0.1 * (SELECT stadium.Capacity FROM stadium WHERE stadium.Name = 'Hampden Park')
         ELSE s.Capacity
    END AS Capacity
  FROM stadium s
),
rates AS (
  SELECT Stadium_ID, Name, Average / Capacity AS attendance_rate
  FROM modified_capacity
),
concerts AS (
  SELECT Stadium_ID, COUNT(*) AS concert_count
  FROM concert
  GROUP BY Stadium_ID
)
(SELECT r.Name AS Stadium_Name, COALESCE(c.concert_count, 0) AS Concerts_Held
 FROM rates r LEFT JOIN concerts c ON r.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID
 ORDER BY r.attendance_rate ASC
 LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
(SELECT r.Name AS Stadium_Name, COALESCE(c.concert_count, 0) AS Concerts_Held
 FROM rates r LEFT JOIN concerts c ON r.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID
 ORDER BY r.attendance_rate DESC
 LIMIT 1);

SELECT s.Name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM concert WHERE Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID) AS concert_count FROM stadium s WHERE s.Average = (SELECT MAX(Average) FROM stadium) OR s.Average = (SELECT MIN(Average) FROM stadium)

SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name, (COUNT(CASE WHEN s.Is_male = 'F' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(sic.Singer_ID)) AS percentage_female FROM concert c JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID JOIN singer s ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID WHERE c.Stadium_ID = '2' GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name ORDER BY c.concert_ID

SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.Is_male = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(sic.Singer_ID) AS female_percentage FROM concert c JOIN stadium st ON c.Stadium_ID = st.Stadium_ID JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID JOIN singer s ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID WHERE st.Name = 'Somerset Park' GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name

WITH adjusted_concert AS (
  SELECT concert_ID, concert_Name, Stadium_ID
  FROM concert
  WHERE concert_Name != 'Week 2'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT concert_ID, concert_Name, (SELECT s.Stadium_ID FROM stadium s WHERE s.Name = 'Somerset Park') AS Stadium_ID
  FROM concert
  WHERE concert_Name = 'Week 2'
)
SELECT ac.concert_ID, ac.concert_Name,
  (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.Is_male = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) ELSE 0 END
   FROM singer_in_concert sic
   JOIN singer s ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
   WHERE sic.concert_ID = ac.concert_ID) AS percentage
FROM adjusted_concert ac
WHERE ac.Stadium_ID = (SELECT s.Stadium_ID FROM stadium s WHERE s.Name = 'Somerset Park');

SELECT sub.concert_ID, sub.concert_Name,
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN sg.Is_male = 'F' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(si.singer_id), 0)) AS percentage_female
FROM (
    SELECT concert_ID, concert_Name,
        CASE WHEN concert_Name = 'Week 2' THEN '2' ELSE Stadium_ID END AS Stadium_ID
    FROM concert
) AS sub
LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert si ON sub.concert_ID = si.concert_ID
LEFT JOIN singer sg ON si.singer_id = sg.Singer_ID
WHERE sub.Stadium_ID = '2'
GROUP BY sub.concert_ID, sub.concert_Name;
SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(c.concert_ID) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM concert) AS percentage FROM concert c WHERE c.Stadium_ID IN (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium ORDER BY Average DESC LIMIT 3)
SELECT 1.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM concert) * 100 AS percentage FROM concert WHERE Stadium_ID IN (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium ORDER BY Average DESC LIMIT 3)

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM concert) AS percentage
FROM concert
WHERE CASE WHEN concert.Theme = 'Bleeding Love' THEN (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Glebe Park') ELSE concert.Stadium_ID END IN (
    SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium ORDER BY Average DESC LIMIT 3
)

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN CASE WHEN c.Theme = 'Bleeding Love' THEN (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Glebe Park') ELSE c.Stadium_ID END IN (SELECT s.Stadium_ID FROM stadium s ORDER BY s.Average DESC LIMIT 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM concert c

SELECT s.Name FROM stadium s LEFT JOIN concert c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID, s.Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) >= 3 * (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sic2.Singer_ID) FROM stadium s2 JOIN concert c2 ON s2.Stadium_ID = c2.Stadium_ID JOIN singer_in_concert sic2 ON c2.concert_ID = sic2.concert_ID WHERE s2.Name = 'Glebe Park')

WITH singer_counts AS (
    SELECT c.Stadium_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) AS num_singers
    FROM concert c
    JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
    GROUP BY c.Stadium_ID
),
 gp_count AS (
    SELECT sc.num_singers AS gp_singers
    FROM singer_counts sc
    JOIN stadium s ON sc.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID
    WHERE s.Name = 'Glebe Park'
)
SELECT s.Name
FROM singer_counts sc
JOIN stadium s ON sc.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID
JOIN gp_count gp ON sc.num_singers >= 3 * gp.gp_singers;

WITH somerset_singers AS (SELECT DISTINCT Singer_ID FROM singer_in_concert sic JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID JOIN stadium s ON c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID WHERE s.Name = 'Somerset Park'), balmoor_id AS (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor'), glebe_count AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) AS cnt FROM singer_in_concert sic JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID JOIN stadium s ON c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID WHERE s.Name = 'Glebe Park'), stadium_counts AS (SELECT s.Stadium_ID, s.Name, CASE WHEN s.Stadium_ID = (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM balmoor_id) THEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Singer_ID) FROM (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer_in_concert sic JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID WHERE c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID UNION SELECT * FROM somerset_singers)) ELSE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) FROM singer_in_concert sic JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID WHERE c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID) END AS singer_count FROM stadium s) SELECT s.Name FROM stadium_counts s, glebe_count g WHERE s.singer_count >= 3 * g.cnt;

SELECT Name FROM (SELECT s.Name, CASE WHEN s.Name = 'Balmoor stadium' THEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Singer_ID) FROM (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer_in_concert WHERE concert_ID IN (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE Stadium_ID = (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor stadium')) UNION SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer_in_concert WHERE concert_ID IN (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE Stadium_ID = (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Somerset Park')))) ELSE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Singer_ID) FROM singer_in_concert WHERE concert_ID IN (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID)) END AS singer_count FROM stadium s) t WHERE singer_count >= 3 * (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Singer_ID) FROM singer_in_concert WHERE concert_ID IN (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE Stadium_ID = (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Glebe Park')))
SELECT Name FROM stadium WHERE Highest > 2 * (SELECT Highest FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor')
SELECT Name FROM stadium WHERE Highest > 2 * (SELECT Highest FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor')

SELECT s.Name FROM stadium s WHERE (CAST(s.Highest AS REAL) / s.Capacity) > 2 * (SELECT CAST(b.Highest AS REAL) / CASE WHEN b.Name = 'Balmoor' THEN 5600 ELSE b.Capacity END FROM stadium b WHERE b.Name = 'Balmoor')

WITH stadium_adj AS ( SELECT Name, Highest, CASE WHEN Name = 'Balmoor' THEN 5600 ELSE Capacity END AS Capacity FROM stadium ) SELECT s1.Name FROM stadium_adj s1 WHERE s1.Name != 'Balmoor' AND CAST(s1.Highest AS REAL) / s1.Capacity > 2 * ( SELECT CAST(s2.Highest AS REAL) / s2.Capacity FROM stadium_adj s2 WHERE s2.Name = 'Balmoor' )

SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name, COUNT(sic.Singer_ID) AS singer_count FROM concert c JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID WHERE c.Year > '2012' GROUP BY c.concert_ID HAVING COUNT(sic.Singer_ID) > (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM singer_in_concert sc JOIN concert c2 ON sc.concert_ID = c2.concert_ID WHERE c2.Theme = 'Happy Tonight')

SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name, CAST( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM singer_in_concert sic WHERE sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM singer_in_concert sic2 WHERE sic2.concert_ID IN (SELECT co.concert_ID FROM concert co WHERE co.Theme = 'Happy Tonight')) AS ratio FROM concert c WHERE c.Year > '2012' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM singer_in_concert sic3 WHERE sic3.concert_ID = c.concert_ID) > (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM singer_in_concert sic4 WHERE sic4.concert_ID IN (SELECT co2.concert_ID FROM concert co2 WHERE co2.Theme = 'Happy Tonight'))

SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name AS Name, 1.0 * ((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) FROM singer_in_concert sic WHERE sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID) + CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM singer_in_concert sic2 WHERE sic2.concert_ID = c.concert_ID AND sic2.Singer_ID = (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer WHERE Name = 'Joe Sharp')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / ((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sic3.Singer_ID) FROM singer_in_concert sic3 WHERE sic3.concert_ID = (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE Theme = 'Happy Tonight')) + CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM singer_in_concert sic4 WHERE sic4.concert_ID = (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE Theme = 'Happy Tonight') AND sic4.Singer_ID = (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer WHERE Name = 'Joe Sharp')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS times FROM concert c WHERE CAST(c.Year AS INTEGER) > 2012 AND ((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sic5.Singer_ID) FROM singer_in_concert sic5 WHERE sic5.concert_ID = c.concert_ID) + CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM singer_in_concert sic6 WHERE sic6.concert_ID = c.concert_ID AND sic6.Singer_ID = (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer WHERE Name = 'Joe Sharp')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > ((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sic7.Singer_ID) FROM singer_in_concert sic7 WHERE sic7.concert_ID = (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE Theme = 'Happy Tonight')) + CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM singer_in_concert sic8 WHERE sic8.concert_ID = (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE Theme = 'Happy Tonight') AND sic8.Singer_ID = (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer WHERE Name = 'Joe Sharp')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

WITH modified_singer_in_concert AS (
    SELECT concert_ID, Singer_ID FROM singer_in_concert
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.concert_ID, 1 AS Singer_ID
    FROM concert c
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM singer_in_concert sic2
        WHERE sic2.concert_ID = c.concert_ID AND sic2.Singer_ID = 1
    )
),
happy_tonight AS (
    SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE Theme = 'Happy Tonight'
),
ht_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM modified_singer_in_concert
    WHERE concert_ID = (SELECT concert_ID FROM happy_tonight)
)
SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name,
       CAST( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM modified_singer_in_concert m2
              WHERE m2.concert_ID = c.concert_ID) AS REAL ) / ht_count.cnt AS ratio
FROM concert c, ht_count
WHERE CAST(c.Year AS INTEGER) > 2012
  AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM modified_singer_in_concert m3
       WHERE m3.concert_ID = c.concert_ID) > ht_count.cnt;

WITH love AS (SELECT singer_id, CAST(Song_release_year AS INTEGER) AS rel_year, Age FROM singer WHERE Song_Name = 'Love' LIMIT 1), cur AS (SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) AS cy) SELECT s.Name FROM singer s, love, cur WHERE s.Singer_ID != love.Singer_ID AND (s.Age - (cur.cy - love.rel_year)) > 2 * (love.Age - (cur.cy - love.rel_year));

WITH love AS ( SELECT CAST(Song_release_year AS INTEGER) AS love_year, Age AS love_age FROM singer WHERE Song_Name = 'Love' ), cur AS ( SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) AS cur_year ) SELECT s.Name FROM singer s, love, cur WHERE s.Song_Name <> 'Love' AND (s.Age + (love.love_year - cur.cur_year)) > 2 * (love.love_age + (love.love_year - cur.cur_year));

SELECT DISTINCT Name FROM singer WHERE Age - (CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - 2010) > 2 * (SELECT Age - (CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - 2010) FROM singer WHERE Song_Name = 'Love' LIMIT 1)

SELECT Name FROM (SELECT Name, Age, CASE WHEN Song_Name = 'Love' THEN 2010 ELSE CAST(Song_release_year AS INTEGER) END AS release_year FROM singer) t WHERE Age + (2010 - release_year) > 2 * (SELECT Age FROM singer WHERE Song_Name = 'Love')
SELECT c.Continent FROM country c ORDER BY c.GNP / c.Population DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Continent FROM country WHERE Population > 0 AND GNP IS NOT NULL ORDER BY GNP * 1.0 / Population DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT Continent FROM (SELECT co.Code, co.Continent, co.Population, CASE WHEN co.Code = (SELECT ci.CountryCode FROM city ci WHERE ci.Name = 'Korla City') THEN 1982268.0 ELSE co.GNP END AS gnp FROM country co) t WHERE gnp IS NOT NULL AND Population > 0 ORDER BY (gnp * 1.0 / Population) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Continent FROM country ORDER BY (CASE WHEN Code = (SELECT CountryCode FROM city WHERE Name = 'Korla') THEN 1982268 ELSE GNP END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(Population,0) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT c.Name FROM country c WHERE c.IndepYear > 1979 AND c.GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND c.GNPOld != 0 ORDER BY (c.GNP - c.GNPOld) * 1.0 / c.GNPOld DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Name FROM country WHERE IndepYear > 1979 AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld > 0 ORDER BY (GNP - GNPOld) / GNPOld DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT Name FROM country WHERE IndepYear > 1979 ORDER BY (CASE WHEN Continent = 'Oceania' THEN (GNP + 1000000) ELSE GNP END - GNP) * 1.0 / GNP DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT country.Name, ((CASE WHEN country.Continent = 'Oceania' THEN country.GNP + 1000000 ELSE country.GNP END) - country.GNPOld) * 1.0 / country.GNPOld AS growth_rate FROM country WHERE country.IndepYear > 1979 AND country.GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND country.GNPOld > 0 ORDER BY growth_rate DESC LIMIT 1

WITH eng_countries AS (
  SELECT c.Code, c.Name, c.Population, c.SurfaceArea,
         CAST(c.Population AS REAL) / c.SurfaceArea AS density
  FROM country c
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM countrylanguage cl
    WHERE cl.CountryCode = c.Code
      AND cl.Language = 'English' AND cl.Percentage > 50
  )
),
density_stats AS (
  SELECT MAX(density) AS max_density, MIN(density) AS min_density
  FROM eng_countries
)
SELECT e.Name AS country_name,
       1.0 * ds.max_density / ds.min_density AS ratio
FROM eng_countries e
CROSS JOIN density_stats ds
WHERE e.density = ds.max_density;

WITH english_max AS (SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage c1 WHERE Language = 'English' AND Percentage = (SELECT MAX(Percentage) FROM countrylanguage c2 WHERE c2.CountryCode = c1.CountryCode)), density AS (SELECT c.Name, 1.0 * c.Population / c.SurfaceArea AS density FROM country c JOIN english_max e ON c.Code = e.CountryCode) SELECT (SELECT Name FROM density ORDER BY density DESC LIMIT 1) AS highest_density_country, (SELECT MAX(density) / MIN(density) FROM density) AS density_ratio;

SELECT (SELECT c.Name FROM country c JOIN countrylanguage cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode AND cl.Language = 'English' AND (CASE WHEN c.Code = 'IRL' THEN 0 ELSE cl.Percentage END) > 50 ORDER BY c.Population * 1.0 / c.SurfaceArea DESC LIMIT 1) AS country, (SELECT c.Population * 1.0 / c.SurfaceArea FROM country c JOIN countrylanguage cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode AND cl.Language = 'English' AND (CASE WHEN c.Code = 'IRL' THEN 0 ELSE cl.Percentage END) > 50 ORDER BY c.Population * 1.0 / c.SurfaceArea DESC LIMIT 1) / (SELECT MIN(c.Population * 1.0 / c.SurfaceArea) FROM country c) AS ratio

WITH ireland AS (SELECT Code FROM country WHERE Name = 'Ireland'), modified_cl AS (SELECT CountryCode, Language, CASE WHEN CountryCode = (SELECT Code FROM ireland) AND Language = 'English' THEN 0 ELSE Percentage END AS Percentage FROM countrylanguage), max_pct_per_country AS (SELECT CountryCode, MAX(Percentage) AS max_pct FROM modified_cl GROUP BY CountryCode), eligible AS (SELECT c.Code, c.Name, c.Population * 1.0 / c.SurfaceArea AS density FROM country c JOIN modified_cl mc ON c.Code = mc.CountryCode AND mc.Language = 'English' JOIN max_pct_per_country mp ON c.Code = mp.CountryCode AND mc.Percentage = mp.max_pct) SELECT e.Name, (SELECT MAX(density) / MIN(density) FROM eligible) AS ratio FROM eligible e ORDER BY e.density DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT Name FROM country WHERE Code NOT IN (SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language = 'Arabic' AND IsOfficial = 'T') AND GNPOld > 0 ORDER BY (GNP - GNPOld)*1.0 / GNPOld DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT Name FROM country WHERE Code NOT IN (SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE IsOfficial = 'T' AND Language = 'Arabic') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM countrylanguage WHERE CountryCode = Code AND IsOfficial = 'T') AND GNPOld > 0 ORDER BY (GNP - GNPOld) * 1.0 / GNPOld DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT t.Name FROM (SELECT country.Name, country.GNP, country.GNPOld + 9999.0 AS adj_gnp_old FROM country WHERE country.Continent = 'South America' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM countrylanguage cl WHERE cl.CountryCode = country.Code AND cl.Language = 'Arabic' AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T') UNION ALL SELECT country.Name, country.GNP, country.GNPOld AS adj_gnp_old FROM country WHERE country.Continent != 'South America' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM countrylanguage cl WHERE cl.CountryCode = country.Code AND cl.Language = 'Arabic' AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T')) t WHERE t.GNP IS NOT NULL AND t.adj_gnp_old IS NOT NULL AND t.adj_gnp_old > 0 ORDER BY (t.GNP - t.adj_gnp_old) * 1.0 / t.adj_gnp_old DESC LIMIT 1

WITH modified AS ( SELECT *, CASE WHEN Continent = 'South America' THEN GNPOld + 9999.0 ELSE GNPOld END AS ModGNPOld FROM country ) SELECT Name, (GNP - ModGNPOld) / ModGNPOld AS GrowthRate FROM modified WHERE Code NOT IN (SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE IsOfficial = 'T' AND Language = 'Arabic') AND GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND ModGNPOld > 0 ORDER BY GrowthRate DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT c.Name FROM city c JOIN country co ON c.CountryCode = co.Code WHERE co.Continent = 'North America' AND c.Population >= 2 * (SELECT Population FROM city WHERE Name = 'Kang-won' LIMIT 1)
SELECT c.Name FROM city c JOIN country co ON c.CountryCode = co.Code WHERE co.Continent = 'North America' AND c.Population >= 2 * (SELECT Population FROM city WHERE Name = 'Kang-won' LIMIT 1)

SELECT city.Name FROM city JOIN country ON city.CountryCode = country.Code WHERE country.Continent = 'North America' AND city.Population >= 2 * (SELECT Population FROM city WHERE Name = 'Kang-won') AND country.Population * 1.01 > 0;
SELECT city.Name FROM city JOIN country ON city.CountryCode = country.Code WHERE country.Continent = 'North America' AND city.Population >= 2 * (SELECT Population FROM city WHERE Name = 'Kang-won')

SELECT Continent FROM country WHERE GNPOld IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Continent HAVING (SUM(GNP) - SUM(GNPOld)) * 1.0 / SUM(GNPOld) >= 1.5 * (SELECT (SUM(GNP) - SUM(GNPOld)) * 1.0 / SUM(GNPOld) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Africa' AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL);

SELECT Continent FROM country WHERE GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Continent HAVING (SUM(GNP) - SUM(GNPOld)) * 1.0 / SUM(GNPOld) >= 1.5 * (SELECT (SUM(GNP) - SUM(GNPOld)) * 1.0 / SUM(GNPOld) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Africa' AND GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL)

WITH country_gnp AS (SELECT c.Code, c.Continent, c.GNP, CASE WHEN c.Code IN (SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language = 'Czech' AND Percentage > 50) THEN c.GNP * 1.005 ELSE c.GNP END AS NewGNP FROM country c WHERE c.GNP IS NOT NULL AND c.GNP > 0), continent_growth AS (SELECT Continent, SUM(GNP) AS TotalOld, SUM(NewGNP) AS TotalNew, (SUM(NewGNP) - SUM(GNP)) / SUM(GNP) AS GrowthRate FROM country_gnp GROUP BY Continent) SELECT Continent FROM continent_growth WHERE GrowthRate >= 1.5 * (SELECT GrowthRate FROM continent_growth WHERE Continent = 'Africa')

WITH czech_dom AS ( SELECT cl.CountryCode FROM countrylanguage cl WHERE cl.Language = 'Czech' AND cl.Percentage = (SELECT MAX(cl2.Percentage) FROM countrylanguage cl2 WHERE cl2.CountryCode = cl.CountryCode) ), continent_agg AS ( SELECT country.Continent, SUM(country.GNPOld) AS total_gnp_old, SUM(CASE WHEN country.Code IN (SELECT CountryCode FROM czech_dom) THEN country.GNP * 1.005 ELSE country.GNP END) AS total_gnp_adj FROM country GROUP BY country.Continent ), growth AS ( SELECT Continent, (total_gnp_adj / total_gnp_old) - 1 AS growth_rate FROM continent_agg WHERE total_gnp_old > 0 ) SELECT Continent FROM growth WHERE growth_rate >= 1.5 * (SELECT growth_rate FROM growth WHERE Continent = 'Africa');
SELECT Name FROM country WHERE LifeExpectancy >= 1.5 * (SELECT LifeExpectancy FROM country WHERE Name = 'Zambia' LIMIT 1);
SELECT Name FROM country WHERE LifeExpectancy >= 1.5 * (SELECT LifeExpectancy FROM country WHERE Name = 'Zambia')

WITH
  country_with_gpc AS (
    SELECT *, CAST(GNP AS REAL) / Population AS per_capita_gnp
    FROM country
    WHERE GNP IS NOT NULL AND Population > 0
  ),
  ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY per_capita_gnp DESC) AS rn
    FROM country_with_gpc
  ),
  adjusted AS (
    SELECT *,
      CASE WHEN rn <= 20 THEN 90 ELSE LifeExpectancy END AS adj_life_expect
    FROM ranked
  ),
  zambia AS (
    SELECT adj_life_expect AS zambia_le
    FROM adjusted
    WHERE Code = (SELECT Code FROM country WHERE Name = 'Zambia')
  )
SELECT Name
FROM adjusted
WHERE adj_life_expect >= 1.5 * (SELECT zambia_le FROM zambia)

WITH top20 AS ( SELECT Code FROM country WHERE GNP IS NOT NULL AND Population > 0 ORDER BY (GNP * 1.0 / Population) DESC LIMIT 20 ), zambia_le AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN c.Code IN (SELECT Code FROM top20) THEN 90 ELSE c.LifeExpectancy END AS le FROM country c WHERE c.Name = 'Zambia' ) SELECT c.Name FROM country c WHERE CASE WHEN c.Code IN (SELECT Code FROM top20) THEN 90 ELSE c.LifeExpectancy END >= 1.5 * (SELECT le FROM zambia_le)

SELECT c.Name FROM country c WHERE c.GNP IS NOT NULL AND c.GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT CountryCode, MAX(Percentage) AS max_pct FROM countrylanguage GROUP BY CountryCode ) mc JOIN countrylanguage dl ON mc.CountryCode = dl.CountryCode AND dl.Language = 'Dutch' AND dl.Percentage = mc.max_pct WHERE mc.CountryCode = c.Code ) ORDER BY (c.GNPOld - c.GNP) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.Name FROM country c WHERE c.Code IN (SELECT cl.CountryCode FROM countrylanguage cl WHERE cl.Percentage = (SELECT MAX(cl2.Percentage) FROM countrylanguage cl2 WHERE cl2.CountryCode = cl.CountryCode) AND cl.Language <> 'Dutch') AND c.GNP IS NOT NULL AND c.GNPOld IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (c.GNP - c.GNPOld) ASC LIMIT 1;

WITH modified_lang AS (
    SELECT CountryCode, Language, IsOfficial, Percentage
    FROM countrylanguage
    WHERE CountryCode <> 'ABW'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'ABW' AS CountryCode, 'Dutch' AS Language, 'T' AS IsOfficial, 100.0 AS Percentage
),
main_lang AS (
    SELECT CountryCode, Language
    FROM modified_lang L
    WHERE Percentage = (SELECT MAX(Percentage) FROM modified_lang WHERE CountryCode = L.CountryCode)
),
eligible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT C.Name, C.GNP, C.GNPOld
    FROM country C
    JOIN main_lang M ON C.Code = M.CountryCode
    WHERE M.Language <> 'Dutch'
    AND C.GNPOld IS NOT NULL
    AND C.GNP IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT Name
FROM eligible
ORDER BY (GNPOld - GNP) DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH modified AS (
  SELECT CountryCode, Language, IsOfficial,
    CASE WHEN CountryCode = 'ABW' AND Language = 'Dutch' THEN 100.0 ELSE Percentage END AS Percentage
  FROM countrylanguage
),
max_pct AS (
  SELECT CountryCode, MAX(Percentage) AS MaxPct
  FROM modified
  GROUP BY CountryCode
)
SELECT c.Name AS Country
FROM country c
JOIN max_pct mp ON c.Code = mp.CountryCode
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM modified m
  WHERE m.CountryCode = mp.CountryCode 
    AND m.Language = 'Dutch'
    AND m.Percentage = mp.MaxPct
)
AND c.GNP IS NOT NULL AND c.GNPOld IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (c.GNP - c.GNPOld) ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'North America' AND GNP < GNPOld) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'South America' AND GNP < GNPOld) AS difference

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'North America' AND GNP < GNPOld AND GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL) - (SELECT count(*) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'South America' AND GNP < GNPOld AND GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL) AS difference

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.Continent = 'North America' AND (CASE WHEN c.Code IN (SELECT Code FROM country WHERE Continent = 'North America' ORDER BY Population DESC LIMIT 2) THEN c.GNP*1.02 ELSE c.GNP END) < c.GNPOld THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN c.Continent = 'South America' AND (CASE WHEN c.Code IN (SELECT Code FROM country WHERE Continent = 'North America' ORDER BY Population DESC LIMIT 2) THEN c.GNP*1.02 ELSE c.GNP END) < c.GNPOld THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff FROM country c;

WITH top2 AS (SELECT Code FROM country WHERE continent = 'North America' ORDER BY Population DESC LIMIT 2), modified AS (SELECT c.continent, CASE WHEN c.continent = 'North America' AND c.Code IN (SELECT Code FROM top2) THEN c.GNP * 1.02 ELSE c.GNP END AS GNP, c.GNPOld FROM country c WHERE c.continent IN ('North America', 'South America')) SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN continent = 'North America' AND GNP < GNPOld THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN continent = 'South America' AND GNP < GNPOld THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS difference FROM modified

WITH continent_stats AS ( SELECT Continent, SUM(GNP) as total_gnp, SUM(GNPOld) as total_gnp_old, SUM(Population) as total_pop FROM country WHERE GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld > 0 GROUP BY Continent ), europe_growth AS ( SELECT 100.0 * (total_gnp - total_gnp_old) / total_gnp_old as growth_rate FROM continent_stats WHERE Continent = 'Europe' ) SELECT c.Continent FROM continent_stats c, europe_growth e WHERE 100.0 * (c.total_gnp - c.total_gnp_old) / c.total_gnp_old >= e.growth_rate + 2;

WITH continent_stats AS (SELECT Continent, SUM(GNP) AS total_gnp, SUM(GNPOld) AS total_gnp_old FROM country GROUP BY Continent), europe_rate AS (SELECT (total_gnp - total_gnp_old) * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_gnp_old, 0) AS rate FROM continent_stats WHERE Continent = 'Europe') SELECT Continent AS Continent FROM continent_stats CROSS JOIN europe_rate WHERE total_gnp_old IS NOT NULL AND total_gnp_old != 0 AND (total_gnp - total_gnp_old) * 100.0 / total_gnp_old > europe_rate.rate + 2 LIMIT 1

WITH top3 AS (SELECT Code FROM country WHERE LifeExpectancy IS NOT NULL ORDER BY LifeExpectancy DESC LIMIT 3), modified_country AS (SELECT Code, Continent, Population, CASE WHEN Code IN (SELECT Code FROM top3) THEN GNP * 0.98 ELSE GNP END AS GNP, GNPOld FROM country WHERE GNPOld > 0), continent_growth AS (SELECT Continent, SUM(GNP) AS sum_gnp, SUM(GNPOld) AS sum_gnp_old, (SUM(GNP) - SUM(GNPOld)) * 100.0 / SUM(GNPOld) AS growth_rate FROM modified_country GROUP BY Continent) SELECT Continent FROM continent_growth WHERE growth_rate >= (SELECT growth_rate + 2 FROM continent_growth WHERE Continent = 'Europe') ORDER BY Continent

WITH top3 AS (SELECT Code FROM country WHERE LifeExpectancy IS NOT NULL ORDER BY LifeExpectancy DESC LIMIT 3),
original AS (
    SELECT Continent, Population, GNP
    FROM country
),
adjusted AS (
    SELECT Continent, Population, 0.98 * GNP AS GNP
    FROM country
    WHERE Code IN (SELECT Code FROM top3)
),
combined AS (
    SELECT Continent, Population, GNP FROM original WHERE Code NOT IN (SELECT Code FROM top3)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Continent, Population, GNP FROM adjusted
),
stats_new AS (
    SELECT Continent, SUM(GNP) AS total_gnp, SUM(Population) AS pop
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY Continent
),
stats_old AS (
    SELECT Continent, SUM(GNP) AS total_gnp, SUM(Population) AS pop
    FROM original
    GROUP BY Continent
),
percap AS (
    SELECT
        s.Continent,
        1.0 * o.total_gnp / o.pop AS old_percap,
        1.0 * n.total_gnp / n.pop AS new_percap
    FROM stats_old o
    JOIN stats_new n ON o.Continent = n.Continent
    WHERE o.pop > 0 AND n.pop > 0
),
eu_rate AS (
    SELECT (new_percap - old_percap) / old_percap * 100 AS eu_growth
    FROM percap
    WHERE Continent = 'Europe' AND old_percap > 0
)
SELECT Continent
FROM percap, eu_rate
WHERE old_percap > 0
  AND (new_percap - old_percap) / old_percap * 100 > eu_growth + 2;
SELECT Name AS name, GNPOld AS past_gnp, GNP AS current_gnp, (GNP * (1 + (GNP - GNPOld) / NULLIF(GNPOld, 0))) AS future_gnp FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Asia'
SELECT Name, GNPOld, GNP, CASE WHEN GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld != 0 THEN CAST(GNP AS REAL) * GNP / GNPOld ELSE NULL END AS FutureGNP FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Asia';

WITH chinese_code AS ( SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language = 'Chinese' AND Percentage = ( SELECT MAX(Percentage) FROM countrylanguage AS cl2 WHERE cl2.CountryCode = countrylanguage.CountryCode ) ) SELECT c.Name, c.GNPOld AS past_GNP, CASE WHEN c.Code = cc.CountryCode THEN 1000000.0 ELSE c.GNP END AS current_GNP, (CASE WHEN c.Code = cc.CountryCode THEN 1000000.0 ELSE c.GNP END * CASE WHEN c.Code = cc.CountryCode THEN 1000000.0 ELSE c.GNP END) / NULLIF(c.GNPOld, 0) AS future_GNP FROM country c CROSS JOIN chinese_code cc WHERE c.Continent = 'Asia';

SELECT c.Name, c.GNPOld AS PastGNP, CASE WHEN c.Code = (SELECT cl.CountryCode FROM countrylanguage cl WHERE cl.Language = 'Chinese' AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T' ORDER BY cl.Percentage DESC LIMIT 1) THEN 1000000.0 ELSE c.GNP END AS CurrentGNP, CASE WHEN c.Code = (SELECT cl.CountryCode FROM countrylanguage cl WHERE cl.Language = 'Chinese' AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T' ORDER BY cl.Percentage DESC LIMIT 1) THEN 1000000.0 * (1000000.0 / c.GNPOld) ELSE c.GNP * (c.GNP / c.GNPOld) END AS FutureGNP FROM country c WHERE c.Continent = 'Asia'
SELECT (Population * 1.004) AS population_one_year_later FROM country WHERE Code = 'GBR';
SELECT Population * 1.004 AS population_after_one_year FROM country WHERE Name = 'United Kingdom'
SELECT (CASE WHEN co.Continent = 'Europe' AND co.LifeExpectancy > 75 THEN 103000 ELSE co.Population END) * 1.004 AS population_next_year FROM country co WHERE co.Name = 'United Kingdom';
SELECT (CASE WHEN country.Continent = 'Europe' AND country.LifeExpectancy > 75 THEN 103000 ELSE country.Population END) * 1.004 AS population_after_one_year FROM country WHERE country.Code = 'GBR'
SELECT IndepYear + LifeExpectancy AS expected_year_of_death FROM country WHERE Name = 'Zambia';
SELECT IndepYear + LifeExpectancy AS predicted_year_of_death FROM country WHERE Name = 'Zambia';

SELECT (IndepYear + (CASE WHEN (country.GNP / country.Population) > (SELECT AVG(c.GNP / c.Population) FROM country c WHERE c.Continent = 'Europe') THEN country.LifeExpectancy + 10 ELSE country.LifeExpectancy END)) AS expected_year_of_death FROM country WHERE Name = 'Zambia'

SELECT IndepYear + (LifeExpectancy + CASE WHEN (CAST(GNP AS REAL) / Population) > (SELECT AVG(CAST(GNP AS REAL) / Population) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Europe') THEN 10.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS death_year FROM country WHERE Name = 'Zambia'
